title: Cast prayer requests
description: The Cast's own prayer requests (cast/prayer-requests.json). validate-cast.js checks the rules a schema cannot: requesters, categories, groups, dates for each state, and that at least 8 are current.

requester.description: A Cast person's Guid. Leave out for a guest.

guest.description: Someone with no person record. Rock keeps only the name and email they typed.

category.description: A category key from configuration/prayer.json with a weight above 0.

entered.description: When the request was entered: daysAgo for recent requests, or yearsAgo with a month and day.

state.description: current: approved and in the prayer session (entered 1 to 5 days ago). waiting: not approved yet (1 to 5 days ago). flagged: flagged back to the approval queue (1 to 13 days ago). expired: past its 14 days. answered: expired, with an answer.

isPrivate.description: Private requests are not public in Rock.

group.description: The key of a Cast small group the requester is a current member of.

prayers.description: How many times the prayer team prayed for it. 0 for a waiting request.

by.description: team: a prayer team member who prayed for it. requester: a reply to the first team comment.
